activity_summary: The lane was noisy with people back from the other bank and the jokes still in them. You said you were not going over to learn the jokes. You shut the casement. The talker is still talking, and you do not know the how. You went to bed early, for first light.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Shut the window, named what he does not know, and stopped.

facets.activity: Shut the casement and went to bed early

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The lane is full of them, back from the other bank

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The talker is still talking. I don't know the how.
